description: This script manages Google Sheets updates based on build/test data, including retrieving build info, parsing test step logs, generating formulas, and updating sheets with test results and filters.

methods.name: get_latest_success_build_info
methods.description: Retrieves info about the latest successful build for a given bot, including build name, link, timestamp, angle revision, and chromium revision.

methods.name: get_step_names
methods.description: Gets list of step names starting with 'angle_' from a build, indicating relevant test steps.

methods.name: validate_step_info
methods.description: Validates parsed step info, checking if totals match sum of individual results.

methods.name: get_step_info
methods.description: Parses detailed test step logs to extract statistics like pass/fail counts, handling formatting issues.

methods.name: get_bot_info
methods.description: Compiles build info and step data for a specific bot, including parsing individual step logs.

methods.name: get_spreadsheet
methods.description: Fetches spreadsheet metadata from Google Sheets API.

methods.name: format_sheet_name
methods.description: Generates a human-readable sheet name based on bot and step info, cleaning and formatting test names.

methods.name: get_sheet_names
methods.description: Generates list of sheet names to be used in the spreadsheet based on build info.

methods.name: sheet_exists
methods.description: Checks if a sheet with a given name exists in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: validate_sheets
methods.description: Determines which sheets need to be created to match expected sheet names.

methods.name: batch_update
methods.description: Performs batch updates to Google Sheets, such as adding sheets or setting filters.

methods.name: create_sheets
methods.description: Creates new sheets in the spreadsheet for specified sheet names.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Retrieves header row data from each sheet to determine column structure.

methods.name: batch_update_values
methods.description: Updates cell ranges in sheets with new header or data rows.

methods.name: get_sheet_id
methods.description: Gets the internal sheet ID for a sheet given its name.

methods.name: update_filters
methods.description: Sets filters on sheets to hide duplicate rows based on 'duplicate' column.

methods.name: update_headers
methods.description: Ensures all required and dynamic columns are present in sheet headers.

methods.name: append_values
methods.description: Appends a row of data to a specified sheet.

methods.name: update_values
methods.description: Populates sheets with latest build/test data, creating sheets and headers as needed.

methods.name: update_spreadsheet
methods.description: Main function to update entire spreadsheet with build/test info.

methods.name: get_sheets_service
methods.description: Initializes Google Sheets API service with OAuth credentials.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for auth path, spreadsheet ID, and verbosity.

methods.name: initialize_logging
methods.description: Sets up logging configuration based on verbosity level.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution flow: sets up environment, builds info, and updates spreadsheet.
